item.title: Robert Kraft’s attempts to silence Macklemore have backfired spectacularly | Arwa Mahdawi
item.description: The billionaire’s attempted crackdown on Ed Sheeran’s tour only amplified pro-Palestinian statements. item.title: Meet Myreen Ahsan, the Friendswood 8th-grader who screened over 10 million drug-like molecules
item.description: In a remarkable achievement, eighth-grader Myreen Ahsan has successfully screened over ten million drug molecules using artificial intelligence in her research targeting treatments for frontotemporal dementia. This groundbreaking project has not only showcased her innovative skills but also secured her position as a national finalist in a prestigious science competition. Myreen will present her impressive findings in Washington, D.C. later this year, demonstrating the potential of machine learning in medicine. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
